payload.title: A reader on one site never sees the other site's stories
payload.description:
Scoping must hold everywhere a list is built.

```gherkin
Feature: No cross-site leaks

  Scenario: Lists are scoped
    Given stories published on both sites
    When the home page, section pages, feeds, search and Markdown versions of site two are built
    Then none of them contains a story from site one

  Scenario: The newsroom is scoped
    Given an editor working on site two
    When they list Stories, References and ideas
    Then they see only site two's records
```
